exchanges: hiii
Hi! How is the first week going?
chaotic. waterloo is huge i got lost 3 times today
That happens to almost everyone at first. The campus map helps.
ya i found it eventualy. my floormate kwame walked me to the math building
Nice of him to help.
kwame is nice. he had Coldplay blasting all night tho, says theyre the best band ever made
Strong opinion. At least it is easy listening.
i miss my cat so much. Tofu has been sleeping on my bed every night since i left apparently
That is sweet and a little sad. How old is he?
like 6. hes a big orange loaf
Orange cats do have a reputation for being lovable.
my best friend sam from home keeps texting me about Arcane, shes making me watch it so we can talk about it
A shared show is a nice way to stay close from a distance.
i fell asleep during ep 1 lol dont tell her
Your secret is safe. It does pick up after the first episode.
omg the dining hall pizza destroyed me. im lactose intolerant and forgot my pills
Ouch. Maybe keep some pills in your bag from now on.
good idea. signed up for the boxing club!! sessions are mondays
That will be a good stress outlet.
ya i need it. chem is already kicking my butt
Early chem units can be a lot. Office hours might help.
my lab ta is also named sam lol. different sam. hes cool
Two Sams to keep track of now.
he was telling the whole lab hes binging Shogun and wont shut up abt it
Sounds like he is hooked.
my cousin zainab is getting married!!!
Congratulations to her! Do you know when and where yet?
October, at some banquet hall in Brampton. im so excited
A fall wedding sounds lovely.
i need a dress tho and im broke
Thrift stores or renting a dress could help with that.
ooh renting is smart
Lots of students do it for formal events.
wait no i looked at the club schedule, boxing is wednesdays not mondays
Good thing you checked before showing up on the wrong night.
yes lol. ok gonna try to do chem homework
Good luck. Taking it one problem at a time helps.
cant focus. kwame is playing music again
Headphones with some quiet music might help you focus.
ya. ok actually done 2 problems
That is progress.
slow progress lol
Slow progress still counts.
my nonna rosa just called me, she wanted to know if im eating
That is sweet of her to check in.
btw whats the series my bestie sam wanted me to get into
lol ok. nonna rosa also reminded me shes proud to be Sicilian and i better never put cream in carbonara
Your nonna has her priorities straight.

earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your best friend Sam wanted you to watch Shogun.
